question: What transformation of the body is claimed after the veil of ignorance is struck away?
premises: The speaker refers to their body today.
The body is described as pure.
It was previously struck by the veil of ignorance.
inference: The body is now experienced as pure, having been freed from the veil of ignorance.
uncertainties: deham appears in accusative form but functions as subject in context.
plain_english: Today my body is pure, having been struck free from the veil of ignorance.
